methodology.title: Defensible tokens/s methodology for self-hosted vLLM sizing
steps: 1. Measure, don't quote: run `vllm bench serve` (same tool GPUStack/vLLM use) with your real input/output length distribution (e.g. dataset-name random with your mean in/out, or a replay of real prompts) at several --max-concurrency / request-rate points; report output tok/s, TTFT p50/p95, TPOT p95. Pick the highest concurrency that still meets your latency SLO (not the unconstrained peak).

2. Capacity formula: GPUs = peak_output_tok_s_required / (SLO-constrained output tok_s per GPU x 0.6-0.7 production derate). For offline/batch jobs, use the saturated throughput and GPU-hours = total_tokens / tok_s_per_GPU / 3600.

3. Roofline sanity check (derived): single-stream decode tok/s ~ memory_bandwidth / bytes_read_per_token (active weights; BF16=2B/param, FP8=1B). Aggregate throughput grows ~linearly with batch until compute- or KV-cache-bound. HBM/GDDR bandwidth (NVIDIA datasheets, from memory, not re-verified this session): H100 SXM 3.35 TB/s, A100-80GB 2.0 TB/s, A100-40GB 1.55 TB/s, RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell ~1.8 TB/s, L4 0.30 TB/s. L4 is ~11x lower bandwidth than H100 and only 24GB, so 8B BF16 (16GB) leaves ~4GB KV; use FP8/AWQ/INT4.

4. Memory fit: weights + KV cache + activations <= 0.9 x VRAM. KV bytes/token = 2 x layers x kv_heads x head_dim x bytes. 30B-A3B BF16 (~61GB) barely fits on 80GB -> use FP8 (MoE benefits most: weight/expert traffic halves) ; 27-32B dense BF16 (~54-65GB) leaves little KV on 80GB -> FP8 or 2 GPUs.

5. Report engine/version/precision; FP8 on H100 and FP8 KV cache are the largest legit wins (+44-57% from FP8 KV cache per VESSL; TRT-LLM FP8+chunked-prefill +82% over default vLLM for Qwen3-32B per GPUStack). Prefix caching/speculative decoding depend on workload.
6. Cross-check against Artificial Analysis only for hosted-API speeds (they do not publish single-GPU vLLM numbers) - not used here.

references.workload: ShareGPT, 1000 prompts, vllm bench serve (max concurrency)
references.notes: TRT-LLM FP8+chunked prefill tuned: 2060.4 out / 4284.68 total tok/s. SGLang 814 out; TRT-LLM default 1280 out.
Use as proxy for Gemma-3-12B / 12B class (slightly faster expected).

Tuned (--async-scheduling) ShareGPT total 19,128 tok/s; short/medium/long prompt cases total 28-34k tok/s. Best proxy available for 30B-A3B class; Qwen3-30B-A3B has more total params (BF16 61GB) so expect lower, perhaps 4-8k out tok/s on H100 (derived, unverified).
GPU count per run not captured from page; check source.
Decode ~60 tok/s at short ctx (falls to ~45 at 100k+); 8 concurrent users share, aggregate not tabulated. Only ~2.8x concurrency at 131k ctx.
Inference: B200 FP8 >10x A100 BF16, H100 6.5x A100 (partly FP8 vs BF16). FP8 KV cache +44-57% throughput. See sft_refs.json for training numbers.
